
Telnet Class Library for .NET (version 0.2)
Copyright (c) 2007 David Pinch * http://www.thoughtproject.com/Libraries/Telnet/

-= WARNING =-

This is a very early release so the documentation and source code is far from
complete.  The code is not intended for production systems or novice developers.
It is being released now in hopes that other deveopers will want to help
complete the software.

Please see README.TXT in the Telnet project folder for more information about
licensing (LGPL), known issues, and contact information if you want to
help improve the class library.


-= FOLDERS =-

    Help/

        This folder contains a configuration file for creating the
        developer documentation using the Sandcastle Help File Builder utility,
        which can be found at http://www.codeplex.com/SHFB.

    Reference/

        This folder contains any reference materials (e.g. Request for Comments)
        that may be useful to developers working on the library.

    Samples/

        This folder contains sample applications that use the Telnet library.
        Currently only one sample is provided; this will be expanded over time.
        
    Solution/

        The solution in Visual Studio 2005 format.

    Unit Tests/

        A unit testing solution using NUnit (see www.nunit.org)
